top_signals.title: Brazil Markets Crater, Some Stocks Sink 50% After Lula Victory
top_signals.summary: Brazilian markets cratered, with the currency and the benchmark stock index quickly racking up losses of more than 10%, as the surprise re-election of leftist President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva blew up the bullish wagers that investors had made on the country in recent weeks.

top_signals.title: EU citizens think innovative foods can be useful but want more information, new Eurobarometer shows
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission published the results of a new Special Eurobarometer on food innovation, offering an EU-wide overview of how Europeans view innovative foods, ingredients and crops.
